output_data.text:
[1] Dense Passage Retrieval

We show that retrieval can be practically implemented using dense representations alone, outperforming a strong BM25 system by 9%-19% absolute in top-20 passage retrieval accuracy.

[2] Hybrid retrieval combines sparse lexical matching with dense embeddings, and a cross-encoder reranker reorders the merged candidates before generation.

[3] Query expansion with pseudo-relevance feedback adds terms from top-ranked documents to the original query.
